chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Hammad ibn Isa from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar said:

I saw Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) raising his hands when he bowed, and when he raised his head from bowing, and when he prostrated, and when he raised his head from prostration, and when he intended to prostrate the second time.
ai.seo_question: When does the Imam raise his hands during prayer according to this narration?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the specific ritual practice of raising hands (*raf' al-yadayn*) during the prayer of Imam al-Sadiq (AS), a practice that distinguishes Shia jurisprudence from other schools which often limit this to the opening takbir. It underscores the importance of following the precise physical etiquette (*adab*) of the Imams, reflecting the Shia emphasis on emulating the Prophet's household in worship. The detailed enumeration of these moments serves as a practical guide for believers to ensure their prayers align with the Sunnah of the Ahl al-Bayt.
